What fx returns

Read Term first. The reference page is the fixture note.

This lesson gets you to predict what fx prints for a given input.

The body of fx is return n * 6;. 2026-01-01-fx-snippet

Called with 7, fx returns 42. 2026-01-01-fx-experiment

The source of fx, from 2026-01-01-fx-snippet:

export function fx(n) { return n * 6; }

Input 7, output 42, from 2026-01-01-fx-experiment.

Run fx(3) in a Node shell. You should see 18 printed.
